svg.title: Mock-up 1: fault-injection case with the reference-car outline (layer 1, replaces the ego rectangle)
svg.desc: MOCK-UP: layout and quantities only, illustrative numbers, not a result. Top-down lane view of a loss-of-assist case in a highway curve: the Corolla outline at fault onset, at the 0.5 s SG-01 FTTI, at the driver cue and at the correction, with the lane lines, the body-edge thresholds and the lateral-deviation plot below. Quantities come from the plant results tables when the figure is generated for real.

body edge at lane line, 3.0 m lane: 0.61 m
Lateral deviation of the body edge against time; the orange band is the 0.5 s FTTI of SG-01
deviation at FTTI: the number the result table reports

Generated by assurance/sim/assets/tools/vehicle_figures.py. Mock-up of the layer-1 figure once plant/report.py draws the mesh outline instead of a rectangle; the trajectory shown is illustrative. Synthetic data, no evidence credit.
